candidate_ideas.statement: If 2g-2+n>0 and 2r≤2g+n-2, then H^{2r}(\overline{M}_{g,n};Q) is a direct sum of Q(-r); at equality 2r=2g+n-2 the same holds at least for the kernel of restriction to the boundary.
For (g,n,r)=(6,6,8), the whole group H^{16}(\overline{M}_{6,6};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(-8).

In total degree ≤16, the normalized boundary complex of \overline{M}_{6,6} has as exhaustive primitive entries: (i) even-degree fundamental/ψ/κ/boundary-gluing classes of type Q(-j) in degree 2j; (ii) odd elliptic cusp-form entries beginning at degree 11 with elliptic valence ≥11; (iii) further odd primitives of degree ≥15 with the same or larger flag requirement.

Normalized arc resolution supplies a chain homotopy that pairs every positive-genus primitive generator below degree 2g+n-2 with the graph obtained by adding a missing nonseparating arc, so that after contraction every non-diagonal degree-≤16 entry is an elliptic primitive.

An even total degree can contain an odd primitive only with another odd primitive; two such primitives have intrinsic degree ≥22, so no non-Tate contribution survives in degree 16 of the normalized complex for \overline{M}_{6,6}.
Because H^{16}(\overline{M}_{6,6};Q)≅Q(-8)^{⊕N}, the injected graded piece Gr_{16}^W H_c^{16}(M_{6,6};Q) is likewise a finite direct sum of Q(-8).
W_{-16}H_{16}^{BM}(M_{6,6};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(8) (including the zero sum), and equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)≅Q(-13)^{⊕r}.

Purity of the top graded piece Gr_k^W H_c^k(X;Q) for X=M_{g,n} reduces to purity of a subobject of H^k(\overline{M}_{g,n};Q) whenever the proper-pair weight bound yields Gr_k^W H_c^k↪H^k(\overline{X}).
Genus-one descent is the usual two-term resolution over M_{1,1}, with non-Tate part the parabolic cohomology of Sym^a H occurring in degree a+1, and no cusp forms before a=10.

established_facts.evidence: Observable argument §2: proper-pair sequence for (\overline{M}_{6,6},D) with weight bound from properness and MHS strictness
established_facts.statement: If D=\overline{X}\setminus X is proper, then H^{15}(D;Q) has weights ≤15; strictness of morphisms of mixed Hodge structures applied to the proper-pair sequence H^{15}(D;Q)→H_c^{16}(X;Q)→H^{16}(\overline{X};Q) yields an injection Gr_{16}^W H_c^{16}(X;Q)↪H^{16}(\overline{X};Q).

established_facts.statement: For smooth DM stack X of dimension 21 over Q, Poincaré duality gives H_{16}^{BM}(X;Q)≅H^{26}(X;Q)(21), and the weight pieces match as W_{-16}H_{16}^{BM}≅W_{26}H^{26}(X;Q)(21); formally Q(-8)^∨≅Q(8) and Q(-13)(21)≅Q(8).

established_facts.evidence: Observable argument §1 stable-graph clutching degree bookkeeping
established_facts.statement: On a stable graph with e edges, the clutching map has codimension e and shifts cohomological degree by 2e and Tate type by (-e).

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: At equality the stated lemma controls only the kernel of restriction to the boundary; boundary-supported classes and the full stratified contribution remain uncontrolled, so the whole-group claim is not a formal consequence of the kernel-only limiting case.
invalid_steps.statement: From a low-degree diagonal statement that at 2r=2g+n-2 only ker(H^{2r}(\overline{M}_{g,n})→H^{2r}(D)) is Tate, conclude that the whole group H^{16}(\overline{M}_{6,6};Q) is a direct sum of Q(-8).

invalid_steps.statement: Conclude exhaustiveness of the listed degree-≤16 primitive entries and Tate purity of all terms and differentials in the normalized complex from a one-paragraph arc-resolution/chain-homotopy sketch.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Higher-genus primitive summands and their Gysin-shifted placements require a complete filtration or spectral-sequence analysis; slogan-level genus-one descent does not exclude them.
invalid_steps.statement: After arc contraction, assert that every non-diagonal degree-≤16 entry is elliptic, thereby excluding all genus-≥2 primitive/motive contributions.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Stratum cohomology is the Aut(Γ)-(co)invariants of the Künneth product; omitting this step can create or discard non-Tate summands incorrectly.
invalid_steps.statement: Treat stable-graph strata as contributing Künneth products of vertex cohomologies without passing to Aut(Γ)-invariants or coinvariants.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The injection is valid independently, but purity of a subobject requires purity of the ambient group (or a separate analysis of the image); if H^{16}(\overline{M}_{6,6}) is not established to be Tate, the graded piece remains uncontrolled.
